desc: This cape smells faintly of brimstone. While wearing it, you can use it to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDimensionD]{Dimension Door} as a Magic action. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.
When you teleport with that spell, you leave behind a cloud of smoke. The space you left is &Reference[LightlyObscured] by that smoke until the end of your next turn.
name: cape of the mountebank
